strategy.summary: Keep the ball up top until bonus reaches 15,000, open the lower gate, complete A-B-C-D for Double Bonus, then protect the completed state.

quickInfo.name: Base bonus
quickInfo.summary: Top micro-switches and both return lanes advance base bonus to its 15,000 maximum.

quickInfo.name: Double Bonus
quickInfo.summary: Complete the four A-B-C-D drop targets to double the end-of-ball bonus.

quickInfo.name: Lower gate
quickInfo.summary: The orange top rollover opens the lower gate and gives the ball another path away from the drain.

quickInfo.name: A-B bank shot
quickInfo.summary: A shot from a side rubber can collect both upper A and B targets without two direct attacks.

quickInfo.name: Spinner
quickInfo.summary: The spinner has low value and a dangerous return, so the upper-playfield route is usually safer.

steps.text: Plunge across as many white bonus buttons as possible. Include the orange gate rollover when the lane is available.
Return the ball to the upper playfield until base bonus reaches 15,000.
modeNotes: Base bonus: Top buttons and both return lanes add bonus. The maximum base value is 15,000.

steps.text: Make another top shot when the lower gate is not open. Do not attack A-B-C-D without an available escape path.
Complete A-B-C-D to activate Double Bonus.
modeNotes: A and B: A side-rubber bank shot or a center-bumper rebound can collect these upper targets.
C and D: Shoot these lower targets directly only from a controlled flipper.

steps.text: After Double Bonus and 15,000 base bonus are ready, return to the upper route. Protect the earned 30,000 end-of-ball bonus.
Ignore the spinner unless a harmless feed enters it. Do not trade the protected bonus for low spinner value.

fallback.title: Protect the 15,000 base bonus
fallback.when: Use this when the A-B-C-D targets or lower gate are unsafe.

steps.text: Keep the ball in the top and use return lanes to raise base bonus.
Stop target attacks after base bonus reaches 15,000.
Continue upper-playfield points and avoid the spinner.
Take the single end-of-ball bonus instead of risking the ball for Double Bonus.

alternatives.title: Rubber bank for A-B
alternatives.when: Use this when A and B remain and the direct upper-target path is not available.

steps.text: Aim a controlled shot at the side rubber beside A and B.
Use the bank angle to collect one or both targets.
Stop this route if the rebound reaches a slingshot or outlane.
Use top switches and return lanes to raise base bonus to 15,000.
Roll over the orange top switch to open the lower gate before the drop-target phase.
Complete A-B-C-D to activate Double Bonus.
Protect the completed state through the end of the ball.

techniques.name: A-B rubber bank
techniques.instruction: Bank the ball from the side rubber into the upper A and B targets. Stop after an unsafe rebound.

cautions.issue: The center bumper, drop targets, and spinner can send the ball toward a slingshot, outlane, or center drain.
cautions.response: Use top switches to raise base bonus first. Attack only the remaining A-B-C-D targets after the orange top rollover opens the lower gate.

cautions.issue: A ball from the upper playfield can hit a spinner post and change direction sharply.
cautions.response: Keep both flippers ready after every top exit. Do not assume that the feed will reach an inlane.

checkBeforePlay: Test whether the orange top rollover opens the lower gate and whether that gate stays reliable.
Learn the center-bumper, spinner-post, and drop-target rebounds before leaving the upper route.
Confirm ball count, tilt, Special handling, and any tournament value assigned to extra-ball or replay awards.
strategy.simpleOverview: Star Pool uses top switches and return lanes to build 15,000 base bonus, then A-B-C-D doubles it. Stay upstairs first, roll over the orange top switch to open the lower gate, complete the four drops, and protect the finished 30,000 bonus.
strategy.overview: Star Pool uses top switches and return lanes to build 15,000 base bonus, then A-B-C-D doubles it. Finish the base upstairs, open the gate, then use the side-rubber bank shot for A-B and attack only the remaining drops directly. Preserve the completed 30,000 collect rather than returning to the low-value, dangerous spinner.
